name: agent-messenger
description: Read and send agent-messenger messages from VS Code, through the bus monitor's HTTP API

agentMessenger.url.description: Base URL of the bus monitor, for example http://localhost:8080 or its public URL behind a proxy.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.package: npm run build && cp ../LICENSE LICENSE && vsce package --out agent-messenger.vsix
